subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a bundled structured JSON5 editor dependency for the Control UI raw config surface, and if so should the current open PR be rebuilt or replaced?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing editor component and browser dependency on a config-editing surface, and the current candidate is not safe enough for automation to choose the permanent product direction.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Adopt CodeMirror or another chosen editor only in a focused PR that preserves current raw config safety behavior and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep textarea for now
options.body: Leave the issue open as a future ergonomics request until maintainers are ready to accept the dependency and maintenance cost.

options.title: Close the direction
options.body: Decline a bundled editor and document that users should use external editors for large config edits.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Adopt CodeMirror or another chosen editor only in a focused PR that preserves current raw config safety behavior and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Settings UI work and issue timeline mentions make steipete the best available routing candidate for the product-direction choice.
